Rowan was busking for coins near the festival stalls, playing a song so filthy that three matrons walked away and two came closer. I laughed so hard I choked on candied apple. We talked for four hours. We've been writing letters erratically, across distances that shouldn't allow friendship but somehow do ever since.</p> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">ROWAN</span>"You look like a man deciding which cliff to jump off." They settle onto the bench beside me, adjusting the lute across their lap.</div> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">EDRIN</span>"That's closer to accurate than you think."</div> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">ROWAN</span>"Ah."</div> <p>Rowan doesn't push. That's the thing about them they have the patience of an immortal, which they're technically halfway to being, and the emotional intelligence of someone who has spent their life reading rooms for a living. They set their fingers on the strings and play something soft. Not a performance. A presence.</p> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">EDRIN</span>"I thought you were in Tormark," I say, because saying anything else would mean saying the real thing, and I'm not ready.</div> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">ROWAN</span>"I was. Terrible audiences. The Tormarkians appreciate a twelve-verse ballad about agricultural policy but look at you blankly if you play something with actual emotion. I left before I died of boredom." They glance at me sideways. "I got a letter. From your mother, actually. She said you might need a friend."</div> <p>Of course she did. Of course Mother even from her sickbed, even while dying, even while planning the demolition and reconstruction of her only child's entire existence thought to summon the one person who might make the demolition bearable.</p> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">EDRIN</span>"She's thorough."</div> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">ROWAN</span>"She's your mother. It's the same thing."</div> <p>We sit. Rowan plays. The melody shifts something older now, a song I half-recognize from childhood. The jasmine exhales its sweetness into the cooling air. Above us, the first stars appear the real ones, not the painted kind on library ceilings.</p> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">ROWAN</span>"Whatever it is," Rowan says, not looking at me, fingers still moving on the strings, "you've never been a coward, Edrin. You're the bravest person I know. Not because you're fearless, but because you're terrified of everything and do it anyway."</div> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">EDRIN</span>"What if 'doing it' means losing... myself?"</div> <p>They stop playing. The silence is sudden and specific the kind that happens when someone puts down an instrument after playing for a long time, and the air hasn't yet figured out how to fill the space.</p> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">ROWAN</span>"I've been remaking myself since I was born." Rowan's voice is quiet. "Half of two worlds, belonging fully to neither. Every town I enter, I decide which version of myself to wear. It's not losing yourself. It's finding out which parts were real all along."</div> <p>The words land in a place I didn't know was open. Something behind my sternum shifts not understanding, exactly, but the premonition of understanding. The shadow of a thought I'm not ready to have.</p> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">EDRIN</span>"Stay," I say. "For a few days. I might need..." I don't finish.</div> <div class="dialogue"><span class="speaker">ROWAN</span>"I'm here." Rowan picks up the lute again. "I'm not going anywhere."</div> <p>They play until the stars are thick and the fountain's splash is the only other sound. I don't tell them about the Rite. Not tonight. Tonight I just need someone beside me who doesn't want anything, who isn't angling for position or advantage, who plays music in the garden because the evening is beautiful and that's enough.</p> <p>It's not enough. But it helps.</p> <!-- --- STAT CHANGES --- --> <<set $stress -= 15>> <<set $affRowan += 5>> <<set $d2_gardens to true>> <!-- --- ADVANCE TIME --- --> <<set $timeSlot to "NIGHT">> <!-- --- UPDATE OBJECTIVES --- --> <<completeObjective "follow_music">> <<addObjective "return_chambers" "Return to your chambers it's late" "MAIN">> <<addObjective "speak_perrin" "Speak with the night guard" "SIDE">> <div class="scene-end"> [[Continue → |day-2_hub]] </div><<locationImage "royal_gardens" "Royal Gardens">> <h2>🌿 Royal Gardens</h2> <p>Dusk. Jasmine and woodsmoke. The fountain splashes softly.</p> <<if not $d2_npc_wynn>> <div class="interaction-card side"> <<npcPortrait "wynn" "Old Wynn">> <h4>🌹 The Old Gardener</h4> <p>A bent figure pruning winter roses with metronomic precision.</p> [[Approach|day-2_npc_wynn]] </div> <</if>> <<if not $d2_npc_harwick>> <div class="interaction-card side"> <<npcPortrait "harwick" "Lady Harwick">> <h4>💎 Movement Behind the Topiary</h4> <p>A rustle of silk. A wave of perfume. Someone is lying in wait.</p> [[Investigate|day-2_npc_harwick]] </div> <</if>> <<if not $d2_gardens>> <div class="interaction-card main"> <h4>🎵 The Stone Bench Lute Music</h4> <p>Someone familiar is playing. The melody wanders, finds something beautiful.</p> [[Follow the music|day-2_gardens]] </div> <</if>> <<if $d2_npc_wynn and $d2_npc_harwick and $d2_gardens>> <p class="empty-note">The garden has gone quiet. Just the fountain, the jasmine, and the stars coming out.</p> <</if>> <div class="nav-return"> [[← Return to Palace Hub|day-2_hub]] </div><div class="hub-header"> <h2>Crown's Rest - <<print formatDayNumber($dayNumber)>>: The Summons</h2> <p class="time-display">Time: <<print $timeSlot>></p> <p class="energy-display">Energy: <<print $energy>> | Stress: <<print $stress>></p> </div> <div class="location-grid"> <!-- ========== EDRIN'S CHAMBERS ========== --> <div class="loc-card<<if $d2_woke>> visited<</if>>"> <<locationImage "palace_chambers" "Edrin's Chambers">> <h3>🛏 Edrin's Chambers</h3> <p class="loc-flavor">Your stone-walled bedchamber. Austere. Familiar.</p> <<if not $d2_woke>> <span class="badge main">⚔ Wake Up</span> [[Enter → |day-2_wake]] <<else>> <<if $timeSlot is "NIGHT" and not $d2_night>> <span class="badge main">⚔ Sleep</span> <<elseif not $d2_npc_letter>> <span class="badge side">📜 Examine desk</span> <</if>> [[Enter → |day-2_chambers_explore]] <</if>> </div> <!-- ========== TRAINING YARD ========== --> <<if $d2_woke>> <div class="loc-card<<if $d2_sparred>> visited<</if>>"> <<locationImage "training_yard" "Training Yard">> <h3>⚔ Training Yard</h3> <p class="loc-flavor">Practice blades and chalk-dusted flagstones.
